pinRationale: Deliberately NOT HEAD (which is on Gradle 8.6 as of 2024-08). Pinned to the last commit on Gradle 8.1 so this repo exercises daemon JDK discovery under a JDK-21 runner: Gradle 8.1 cannot run its daemon on JDK 21, so extraction only succeeds if JdkDiscovery falls back to an alternate JDK on the runner image. Verified locally: with JAVA_HOME=21, extraction succeeds and extractionMetadata.daemonJavaHome resolves to a JDK 17 found via java_home, not JAVA_HOME.
groundTruthMethod: gradleVersion/androidSdkVersion/moduleCount were confirmed by reading build files at the pinned commit. jdkVersion and androidBuildToolsVersion are NOT literal build-file values (neither is set explicitly here) — they are gradlezilla's/AGP's own deterministic resolution given this commit's AGP/Gradle/toolchain versions, confirmed by running `gradlezilla generate --dry-run --format json` against this exact pinned checkout twice (once with no Android SDK present at all, once with a full local SDK) and observing byte-identical results both times.

jdkVersion.source: verified run: extractionMetadata.jdkVersionSource="agpMinimum" — no explicit Gradle/Kotlin toolchain declared anywhere; AGP 8.0.2 (gradle/libs.versions.toml androidGradlePlugin=8.0.2) requires JDK 17+, which becomes the resolved jdkVersion even though app/macrobenchmark set an explicit sourceCompatibility of only 17 (JavaVersion.VERSION_17 — consistent here, but note this is the AGP floor, not the source compatibility, that actually drives the value)

androidBuildToolsVersion.source: verified run: not set anywhere in build.gradle.kts files; this is AGP 8.0.2's own default build-tools version, confirmed identical whether or not any build-tools package is actually installed on the machine

moduleCount.source: settings.gradle.kts: include(":app"), include(":macrobenchmark") — no multi-segment includes, so no implicit parent projects; confirmed by verified run

ndkPresent.source: no externalNativeBuild configured — no externalNativeBuild.cmake.path or ndkBuild.path on any module, and no CMakeLists.txt / Android.mk anywhere in the tree

androidNdkVersion.source: not emitted: no module compiles native code. This field was null here before #38 too, but for an unrelated reason — AGP 8.0.2 did not populate its own bundled android.ndkVersion default the way AGP 9.x does

androidCmakeVersion.source: not emitted: no module uses externalNativeBuild.cmake
